---
title: "Labs"
---

Labs referenced by the Pico course. Course-scoped labs live under
`courses/pico/labs/`; reusable labs shared with other courses live under
the repository-root [`labs/`](../../../labs/index.qmd) directory.

## Referenced labs

- [Hello Pico](../../../labs/hello-pico/) — the introductory lab used from
  [Part 1 · Introduction](../part-1/01-introduction/lab.qmd).

## Authoring course-scoped labs

Course-scoped labs live in this directory and follow the shared lab
template. Reuse a repository-root lab when the same lab is useful for more
than one course.
